catholic-encyclopedia-1913-agnetz: A 1913 entry on the Agnetz — the Lamb, the eucharistic bread of the Byzantine rite. Andrew Shipman explains its cutting and use. The priest stamps it with sacred seals. The East's holy loaf, reverently prepared. Liturgy's bread, in Greek form. Its particles feed the faithful communicants.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alexander-max: A 1913 entry on Alexander Seitz — the German painter of the Nazarene school. Gerhard Gietmann praises his frescoes. His art served the Catholic revival. Rome's churches show his work. A painter of the romantic faith. His frescoes adorn the Roman churches.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-amalarius-of-: This 1913 reference piece on Amalarius of Metz — the great reader of the liturgy's hidden sense — tells his tale. John Goggin sets out his way. He found Christ in every rite. The Franks loved his deep books. His works taught the clergy for ages. The Mass's poet priest.
